conditions: once reality catches up with artificial intelligence's marketing

statement.excerpt: I believe that once reality catches up with artificial intelligence's marketing, there will be a dramatic knock-on effect that savages the entire tech industry.

from_speaker: once reality catches up with artificial intelligence's marketing
our_interpretation: I believe expresses confidence rather than a separate factual antecedent.
The antecedent means a broadly recognized mismatch between AI promises and demonstrated technical or commercial performance.
The predicted consequence is severe damage across the technology sector caused by that reassessment, rather than losses confined to an individual AI company.
The claim supplies neither a deadline nor numerical thresholds for the trigger or the damage. An isolated market decline is not by itself decisive evidence of the entire causal sequence.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes the stated reassessment of AI promises and severe, broadly distributed technology-sector damage attributable to it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After an identifiable qualifying reassessment, evidence establishes that its consequences have run their course without severe sector-wide damage. Mere non-occurrence by the evaluation date cannot contradict this undated forecast.
